A straight thick grey-brown trunk with deep furrowed bark, bare for its lowest quarter, narrowing to a point at the tip. Tapering boughs of different lengths all the way up, level or dipping a little and rising at their tips. Each bough is one long solid soft tuft of foliage, thick and chunky, with a lightly tufted scalloped edge, and the boughs are staggered with sky between them. Paint the foliage as thick, solid three-dimensional forms, never as separate needles: no fine needles, no thin lines, no spiky bursts, no thin wisps, no hanging strands, nothing thinner than a limb. Only a small flare in the very bottom of the trunk, no wide base. Whole healthy tree, no broken or snapped top. Stylised cartoon game asset, matte hand-painted colour. Single tree alone, no ground, no base, no text.
